featured.name: Official ATS Convoy - Boat show
featured.description:
### You're **all invited** to haul a boat to Yakima! 👀  

> The yearly Yakima Sprint Boat racing now has a new edition with a regular boat show that is being held at the end of November. For this we require several boats to being hauled to various companies in Yakima from their storage location in Wenatchee.

The event takes place on the **14th November 2026** at **18:00 UTC!**  

---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your timezone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P4sECCF_QEadR)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38596.1792995339.jpg)

---

### :truck: | **Cargo**  

We kindly request you to haul a boat  

You can use our TruckersMP Truck Delivery Dispatcher to select your cargo to Yakima.

![Truck Delivery Dispatcher](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/516fd848-53ae-41ba-9b78-7974591827c0.avif)  

If you want to know more about our Truck Delivery Dispatcher you can read this [article](https://truckersmp.com/knowledge-base/article/1410)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Wenatchee** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you into Coastline Mining.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121346-official-ats-convoy-boat-show/)**!
featured.rule:

* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.  
* Participants should park at their designated slots, which is any non-collision company in Wenatchee.  
* Participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.
* Participants must haul a trailer during the convoy. 
* Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited.
* Cars including alternating vehicles are prohibited except for TruckersMP Event Staff assisting with the event.

today.name: EXPORT OF ELECTRONICS TO EU INOVATION DAYS!
today.description:
## EXPORT OF ELECTRONICS TO EU INOVATION DAYS!
- Export nejmodernější elektroniky na Evropské Inovační Dny. 
## 

-----

![](https://i.imgur.com/VNkKbOc.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/jD3mPFj/CONVOY-RULES.png)


1. Respect the instructions on our Discord server - **Luky Transport Discord Server.**
2. Drive according to the rules and avoid accidents.
3. Follow company rules, they are of great importance.
4. Stick to the prescribed schedule and convoy plan.
5. Have your job and truck ready at the start of the convoy. (FULL FUEL)
6. Cargo is limited to the Electronics.
7. Confirm your participation.
8. If your company has more than 5 members and you want to participate, you must reserve a slot on our Discord server - [link here.](https://discord.gg/lukytransport)
9. The convoy is mainly organized in Czech language, if you need please use translator, we will also use English.

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/PCv3Xb9/schedule.png)

*  **20:00**  - Meetup at parking slots in Stuttgart.
*  **20:30** -  Departure from the Stuttgart, Slots.
*  **20:50** -  Passage trough the city of Hannover.
*  **21:15** -  Passage trough the Germany // BeNeLux border.
*  **21:25** -  Convoy arrival to the Brussels.
*  **21:30** -  Final group photo and end of the event.

![](https://i.imgur.com/qPEhXyX.png)

![](https://i.imgur.com/MyiF3zs.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/CKRRfZ8/CJ.png)

**1. Stuttgart, BCP // Stokes - Brussels, Transinet.**

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/Kctz2JT/SLOT-RESERVATION.png)


To ride on this convoy for companies with more than 5 MEMBERS, slot registration is required.

For this, simply use the new slot feature on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/lukytransport).

**Correct Registration Procedure:**

1. [Select your slot](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225995618955300874) with the code number in the room or on the convoy page.
2. Create a new ticket for booking a slot in the [#ticket room on our Discord.](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225533050616676544)
3. Fill out the registration form, indicating the slot you are interested in.
4. Our management will confirm your registration through the ticket.

*Remember to monitor slot occupancy on the server and communicate with us.*


-----

## SLOTS NO.1 - PUBLIC SLOTS - STOKES.

![](https://i.imgur.com/vP3jkuZ.jpeg)

## SLOTS NO.2 - PRIVATE SLOTS - BCP.

![](https://i.imgur.com/56yZ5HB.jpeg)

## SLOTS NO.3 - RESERVÉ SLOTS - MAIN PARKING.

![](https://i.imgur.com/IThOu3D.jpeg)

*If your company has less than 5 members or you are a member of our company, you do not need to reserve a slot.*


## [FOR RESERVATION OF SLOT VISIT OUR DISCORD!](https://discord.gg/gHnKQqYpHu)

Auf viele weitere Jahre, erfolgreiche Touren und eine starke Gemeinschaft!

Mit freundlichen Grüßen

Für die Teilnahme am KCL-Jubiläumskonvoi am 14.11.2026 gelten folgende Regeln. Wir bitten alle Teilnehmer, diese einzuhalten, damit ein reibungsloser Ablauf gewährleistet ist.

Eure Koggen Crew Logistik KCL 🚛

upcoming.name: Official ATS Convoy - Boat show
upcoming.description:
### You're **all invited** to haul a boat to Yakima! 👀  

> The yearly Yakima Sprint Boat racing now has a new edition with a regular boat show that is being held at the end of November. For this we require several boats to being hauled to various companies in Yakima from their storage location in Wenatchee.

The event takes place on the **14th November 2026** at **18:00 UTC!**  

---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your timezone following **[this](https://notime.zone/P4sECCF_QEadR)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/38596.1792995339.jpg)

---

### :truck: | **Cargo**  

We kindly request you to haul a boat  

You can use our TruckersMP Truck Delivery Dispatcher to select your cargo to Yakima.

![Truck Delivery Dispatcher](https://cdn.truckersmp.com/assets/516fd848-53ae-41ba-9b78-7974591827c0.avif)  

If you want to know more about our Truck Delivery Dispatcher you can read this [article](https://truckersmp.com/knowledge-base/article/1410)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Wenatchee** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you into Coastline Mining.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/121346-official-ats-convoy-boat-show/)**!

Pour que chaque convoi se déroule dans de bonnes conditions, merci de respecter ces quelques règles :

• Respecter le code de la route et les limitations de vitesse.
• Garder une distance de sécurité avec le camion devant soi.
• Ne pas doubler sans autorisation ou raison valable.
• Rester groupé et suivre les consignes du responsable du convoi.

🛣️ KLR TRANS — Un convoi, une équipe, une route.
